note: ADR 1216: an async optimistic setter written through one entry on the creating pass (a named helper called directly at its top level and also handed on, a memo compute, flush(fn) in a helper, a helper a memo and a handler share): Chrome throws OPTIMISTIC_WRITE_BEFORE_LOAD and SC2009 is a violation. A call in an intrinsic element's JSX is a violation too (part 2). A helper called only in a handler, under a branch, from a timer, a lazy memo and a write after an await stay uncertifiable.
